description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the 'ModifyFeatureDefinition' command within an Eclipse Ditto services context. It processes commands to modify or create feature definitions in 'Thing' entities, generating appropriate events and responses.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that processes 'ModifyFeatureDefinition' commands to modify or create feature definitions within 'Thing' entities, producing corresponding events and responses.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the main logic to handle a 'ModifyFeatureDefinition' command, returning a result of this operation.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the specific feature from a 'Thing' based on the command's feature ID.

methods.name: getModifyOrCreateResult
methods.description: Determines whether to modify an existing feature definition or create a new one based on the feature's current state.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Constructs a modification event and response for an existing feature definition.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Constructs a creation event and response for a new feature definition.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the previous entity tag for concurrency control, based on the feature's current definition.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the new entity tag after modification, based on the command's definition.
